_doc: Realistic CI changes for the head-to-head ci-* arms (h2h_walk.py --arm ci-dep | ci-data | ci-env). Each scenario was probed before the run and changes test behaviour at the walked commits: the question is whether each skip rule notices. pins0 / pins1: dependency pins installed after the normal install, before / after the change lands (one virtualenv per profile). edits: byte-level text replacement in a data or fixture file, applied after every checkout from the landing commit on; no test or source file changes with it. env: variables the CI job exports from the landing commit on.

dep.what: lockfile bump of the test runner: pytest 8.4.2 -> 9.1.1 (pytest 9.1 removed _pytest.monkeypatch.notset, which flask's conftest used until July 2026)

a dependency resolution change adds rich 13.0.0 to the test environment (it was absent; e.g. another dev tool pulls it in with an upper bound); structlog's dev console renderer uses rich when it can import it, and rich 13.0 lacks newer keywords (rich 15.0 passes)
